Please describe the specific documentation change here, including which link is broken, so a maintainer can review it. Pull requests are currently limited to collaborators. #4029 is a related discussion about pull requests from forks. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution steps and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) if AI was used. General questions about contributing can also go to [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
